entries.zh: 本次仅修复 CMake 包集成。通过 `find_package(smrcore_peripherals CONFIG)` 引入共享库时，不再查找私有依赖 `Threads` 和 `nlohmann_json`，避免因缺少 `nlohmann_json` 开发包而配置失败。静态库使用方仍会解析这两项依赖；从源码构建库仍需要它们。链接目标仍为 `smrcore::peripherals`。
entries.en: This is a CMake package integration maintenance fix. Importing the shared library with `find_package(smrcore_peripherals CONFIG)` no longer looks up the private dependencies `Threads` and `nlohmann_json`, avoiding configuration failures caused by a missing `nlohmann_json` development package. Static library consumers still resolve both dependencies; building the library from source still requires them. The link target remains `smrcore::peripherals`.

uncertainties.zh: 以上依据配置模板和源码核对，未运行构建或下游集成测试；尚未验证预编译发布包是否包含此修复。
uncertainties.en: These notes were verified against the configuration template and source. Builds and downstream integration tests were not run; inclusion of this fix in prebuilt release packages remains unverified.
